title: A Letter for the Witness
author: Lena Hartwell
blurb: Ada Quintana, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
